support.lead: Write to the academy about a lesson, a payment, a technical problem or anything else. The answers come here and in a message.
support.teacherLead: Write to the academy about a technical problem, your pay or anything else. The answers come here and in a message.

myData.lead: Everything the academy keeps about you and your children: correct your details, download a copy, or ask for an account to be erased.

erase.body: The academy answers within {days} days; once it approves, the account is erased a day later.

fix.contact: The email and mobile number change in

fix.placeholder: For example: the birth year on file is 2016; it is 2017.
fix.refused: The academy did not correct it: {answer}

title.classic: Report a concern about a child's safety

lead.classic: If anything about a lesson, a teacher or anyone on the platform worries you, tell us here. Only the people who keep children safe at the academy read it.
lead.student: If someone made you feel uncomfortable, scared or unsafe, tell us. Only the people who keep students safe at the academy read it, and you will not get in trouble.
lead.kids: If someone made you sad or scared, press a button. A grown-up at the academy will help.
lead.teacher: If something about a student's safety or wellbeing worries you, or another adult's behaviour, tell the academy's safeguarding leads here. Only they read it. Do not look into it or contact the family about it yourself.

text.kids: Do you want to say more? You don't have to.

safeguarding.textHint: When it happened, who was there, what was said: in your own words.
safeguarding.urgent: Someone may be in danger right now
